metric_definitions.SERVICE: A SERVICE stage that still names a parcel is a completed air delivery. The frozen simulator rewrites a segment-clipped service to WAIT and keeps the delivery on the completion stage, whose duration may be the remaining portion of air_service_s.
metric_definitions.U: Every recorded U action has duration phys.handover_s. That is the abnormal handover, separate from the 60 s air SERVICE stage.
metric_definitions.cross: Recovery truck differs from launch truck on the same sortie ref. A cross flight counts when one of its completed SERVICE stages falls between its launch and recovery.
metric_definitions.service_metrics_module: not present in this checkout; counts are taken from the executed segments and observations
